items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: he sent Kimber, you know the best player of Faith? ... he sent him to my house to try to get me to play, join the band

ctx.x: See the boat had their own band, you know, Faith Marble. So Stratford hired me, hired our band, you know, the relief of them, hour on, hour off. And then after that he heard how I played and everything. And he sent Kimber, you know the best player of Faith?
